correctness.rationale: For h0=r+s-1, every kth-power summand is t^k modulo s. Invertibility forces a representation in the h0 class to use at least h0 summands. The minimum such sum is Mk, so Mk-s is bad when positive and N(k)>=Mk-s+1. The inspected k=1 formula and Mk>=M1 give the endpoint comparison.
